Hi Rhea — appreciate the quick turnaround and the clear sample remittance. A couple notes and next steps from our side:

- We do use micro-deposits to verify ACH for new payees unless the customer requires an expedited wire-only route. Micro-deposits are initiated by Redwood Finance and typically clear in 1-2 business days; you will see two small deposits (random cents) and a verification code in the CAD/description.

- For automated invoice application we map against the remittance string token labeled "PO" or "PO_NUMBER". Your sample format (HELIOS-PO-{PO_NUMBER}) will work — we only need the literal PO number to appear somewhere in that segment (e.g., HELIOS-PO-8342). If multiple POs are referenced on a single payment, include them separated by semicolons.

Action items:
1) I'll trigger the ACH micro-deposit test today from Finance (expected in your account by Tue morning).
2) Please confirm the canonical company name you want on our payee record and the email where payment notifications should be sent (we'll use purchasing@heliosbio.com unless you'd prefer a person).
3) If you'd like wire instead, confirm the wire beneficiary name and SWIFT — we can prioritize a manual wire but that will require additional KYC steps.

Looping in Marissa for PO/ops mapping and Jonas for final activation.

Best,
Priyom

- We verified the two micro-deposits (amounts match our outgoing test). Because the transaction memo did not include the verification code, we used the amounts to validate the account; verification complete.
- Your vendor record has been finalized under: Helios Bio, Inc. (Vendor ID: V-98421).
- Preferred remittance parsing rule we applied: search token "PO" or any pattern matching "PO-?\d{3,}". Based on your sample, payments with "HELIOS-PO-<number>" will auto-apply. If a payment lists multiple PO tokens we will create partial allocations and attach a pay note for manual review.

I've attached the PO mapping template populated with our vendor ID and the expected CSV fields for bulk invoice uploads. We will also open an internal ticket (PO-REF-8342) linking this vendor record to your first confirmed PO so your AP team can expect the application.
